About us

Example Town News is an independent newsroom covering council, schools, transit and the people who make this valley home. We have published every weekday since 2019.

We are funded by readers and by a handful of local businesses. Advertisers never see a story before it is published, and they have no say in what we cover or how we cover it.

Our staff of four reporters and one editor works out of the old bank building on Main Street. Drop by any weekday afternoon, or send us a tip through the contact page at any hour.

Corrections are noted at the bottom of the story they fix, with the date of the change. If you spot an error, tell us and we will look into it the same day.
